description: This PHP file defines the class 'DashletsDialog' which manages the retrieval and display of dashboard widgets (dashlets) categorized by types such as Module Views, Charts, Tools, etc., in the SuiteCRM platform.

classes.name: DashletsDialog
classes.description: A class for managing and retrieving dashlets (dashboard components) for the SuiteCRM platform.

methods.name: getDashlets
methods.description: Retrieves and categorizes dashlet metadata, filtering based on permissions and category, and prepares data for display.
